subject: Re: Redwood + LumenAI — procurement path & marketplace interest
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + LumenAI — procurement path & marketplace interest (post-call recap)

Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

What we heard:
- LumenAI is interested in Redwood for inference serving (hosted + potential dedicated for production workloads).
- Primary procurement questions: PO vs corporate card, invoicing cadence, and interest in consolidating through AWS Marketplace (private offer).
- Legal/procurement will want SOC2 evidence and a short MSA for purchase order processing.

Options we can support (details below):
1) Card / self-serve for initial POC — fastest (hours) to get started; good for short pilots.
2) Invoice/PO under Redwood MSA — standard corporate PO process, we can accept net-30/45 depending on terms.
3) AWS Marketplace Private Offer (SPO) — consolidates billing through AWS and can simplify internal procurement for some customers, but requires marketplace onboarding (listing + private offer).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Please confirm preferred commercial path (card / PO / AWS Marketplace Private Offer).
- Share the procurement contact (procurement@ or buyer contact) so we can route the MSA and invoice details properly.
- I attached our current MSA (redwood_msa_v1.pdf) and a marketplace onboarding checklist to illustrate timelines.

Rough timelines we typically see:
- Card: immediate for POC.
- PO/invoice: 1-3 weeks depending on PO issuance and legal redlines.
- AWS Marketplace (private offer): 4-6 weeks to list + secure private offer (varies by SKU and AWS intake).

Links: HubSpot deal -> https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

I'll follow up with a short summary for procurement and copy Jonas to sync on pricing options.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_msa_v1.pdf; marketplace_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@lumenai.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + LumenAI — procurement path & marketplace interest (thanks)

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear options. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- LumenAI prefers to purchase by corporate PO for production purchases. Our standard process is PO + signed MSA; we can accept net-30.
- We are evaluating AWS Marketplace private offers as a longer-term option to centralize spend across our cloud accounts. Could you confirm whether Redwood supports private offers and whether list pricing / SKUs would match your direct pricing?
- SOC2 and security documentation is required before legal signs off — can you share your SOC2 report or a summary, and any standard security questionnaire responses?

Procurement lead is Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>. If you can send the MSA and the invoice template and highlight redline points, we can route to legal and finance.

Also, timeline: we can turn around PO once legal signs the MSA (typically 1-2 weeks after receiving the MSA and SOC2). Marketplace listing would be interesting but may take longer on our side to coordinate with AWS.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Director, Business Operations | LumenAI
aisha.khan@lumenai.com

Subject: Re: Redwood + LumenAI — procurement path & marketplace interest (next steps & options)

Hi Aisha / Procurement team — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers to your questions and a couple of practical paths: 

1) Private Offer on AWS Marketplace: yes, we support private offers and can create a Seller Private Offer (SPO) that mirrors the commercial terms of a direct purchase. List pricing can be aligned but there are constraints around billing cadence & invoicing when routed through AWS — we can walk through options.

2) SOC2 & security docs: attaching our standard SOC2 summary here (we can share the full report under an NDA). I'll include links to our security page and the security questionnaire responses.

3) PO path / MSA: I've attached the MSA (redwood_msa_v1.pdf) and highlighted the sections that typically see redlines (indemnity, data protection, liability caps). If you prefer, we can provide a DocuSign link to speed signature.

Recommended pragmatic path for a first engagement:
- Start POC immediately on a short-term card or invoice for a month of usage so engineering can validate performance.
- Parallel: legal/procurement review MSA and SOC2. Once signed, convert to a PO and apply consumption credits against the initial POC (we can reflect that in the invoice).
- If LumenAI wants centralized cloud billing, we can begin AWS Marketplace onboarding in parallel — we will coordinate with your AWS account team and provide the onboarding checklist.

Links: AWS Marketplace onboarding guide -> https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/solutions/redwood-inference
DocuSign MSA (preview) -> https://app.redwood.com/docusign/msapreview/RBC-2026-145
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Would you be able to share the procurement PO template (or let us know any mandatory contract terms) so we can pre-populate the invoice?

Thanks,
Camila

Attachments: redwood_msa_v1.pdf (attached previously); marketplace_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Subject: Re: Redwood + LumenAI — procurement path & marketplace interest (pricing / pilot idea)

Hi Aisha, Camila — quick note from Sales Lead perspective: 

- To reduce friction I'd propose a short-term pilot (1-3 months) that LumenAI starts immediately on a card (or invoice) while legal runs the MSA. We'll issue a credit for the pilot equal to 50% of the first month if you convert to a PO within 30 days — that makes it low-risk to start.
- For Marketplace: we can provide a private offer that mirrors your negotiated terms; our marketplace team will help with listing and AWS coordination. Typical onboarding 4-6 weeks, but we can accelerate with a joint AWS contact.
- Deal ID: RBC-2026-145 — Camila, let's include 10% introductory discount for the first 90 days and mark in HubSpot.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
